query: У нас уже есть логотип в assets/logo.svg и палитра в tailwind.config.js. Хочу нормальную дизайн-систему вокруг этого.
expected_behavior: Detects state 'assets' via the survey and runs the intake protocol instead of scaffolding over the existing work
Extracts the tailwind palette into primitive tokens and layers semantic tokens on top
Reports found / inferred / missing separately and asks the operator to confirm the inferred items
assertions: No existing file was overwritten, renamed in place, or deleted; assets were copied into design/ with the originals left intact
scaffold_design.py was invoked with --adopt (no placeholder brand or icon files written)
The tailwind colour scale appears as color.palette.* primitives, and at least six semantic tokens (color.bg.*, color.fg.*, color.border.*, color.accent.*) reference them by alias
The report separates three explicit lists: found-and-placed, inferred (needing confirmation), and missing-against-the-non-negotiables
The dark theme is produced as a second set of semantic values, not by inverting lightness, and is flagged as inferred
A dedicated favicon-safe mark is identified as missing rather than generated by shrinking the existing logo
